description: LLM agent 的有界自纠错长期记忆层：把连续、含矛盾的项目交互日志蒸馏成有界、可自更新的记忆库。Bounded, self-correcting long-term memory for LLM agents — candidate pool + value dynamics + tension adjudication + causal-replay evals.
